question: Which of the following cities is NOT one of the traditional locations for the Kumbh Mela?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Varanasi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• **Kumbh Mela** is a major Hindu pilgrimage celebrated at four locations in India: **Haridwar** (Uttarakhand), **Ujjain** (Madhya Pradesh), **Nashik** (Maharashtra), and **Prayagraj** (Uttar Pradesh).

• The event is organized based on the alignment of celestial bodies and occurs every 12 years at each of the four traditional locations, with a rotation of the sites for the main event.

• Among the given options, **Varanasi** is not traditionally associated with hosting the Kumbh Mela, although it is a significant religious city and a spiritual hub for Hindus.
